external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor device installed on customer sites and outside the system operator's physical control.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: The text says the nodes are outside the system operator's physical control.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts readings from sensor nodes and forwards accepted readings to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: The gateway is exposed to the internet. Nodes authenticate with a pre-shared key that is per fleet and has not been rotated since deployment.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them into the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used by the gateway to check device keys and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service onto which the gateway forwards accepted readings.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing sensor telemetry, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the telemetry lake in BigQuery. The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The text does not say whether nodes verify a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
data_flows.notes: The pre-shared key is per fleet rather than per device, and nobody has rotated it since deployment.

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read because making the nodes authenticate to it was awkward. The text does not say whether nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: I don't know what authentication that console has, if any.

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: Customer-controlled sites where sensor nodes are installed and technicians service them.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the telemetry normalizer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators view dashboards.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry contains confidential data because it stores device keys and customer associations.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the registry is used to check the key and determine which customer the node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains confidential data because it stores site addresses and occupancy patterns described as customer data.
assumptions.basis: The source states: 'The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.'

assumptions.assumption: The Cloud Storage bucket's contents are public because the source explicitly says the bucket is public read.
assumptions.basis: The source states: 'The bucket is public read.'
